# vendor/

Patched third-party crates, used as path dependencies through `[patch.crates-io]` or the
workspace dependency table in the root `Cargo.toml`.

| Crate | Upstream | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `iced_aw` | https://github.com/iced-rs/iced_aw | MIT (see `iced_aw/LICENSE`) |
| `iced_fonts` | https://github.com/Redhawk18/iced_fonts | MIT (see `iced_fonts/LICENSE`) |

## Patches to the sources

- `iced_aw/src/widget/menu/menu_bar_overlay.rs`, `draw`: the first dropdown of the menu bar
  is drawn inside its own `with_layer`, as its nested submenus already were. The runtime
  draws overlays without opening a layer, so the dropdown's background quad joined the
  window's last layer, and that layer's text, icons and canvas meshes (drawn after its
  quads) showed through the open menu. Pinned by `menu_bar::layer_tests` in `signex-app`.

## Scope of the checks

`vendor/` sits outside the `license-guard` clean-room grep and the file-size gate; both only
look at `crates/**`. Review changes here by hand. `iced_aw` is excluded from the workspace, so
`--workspace` skips its tests; the `test · workspace` CI job runs them with
`cargo nextest run -p iced_aw --profile ci` and `cargo test -p iced_aw --doc`, and the
`check` job lints it with `cargo clippy -p iced_aw --all-targets`; the `[lints]` table in `vendor/iced_aw/Cargo.toml` makes every rustc and clippy warning an error, also in normal builds (#2206).
Run `cargo test -p iced_aw` locally.

## Fonts

Only one font file is compiled in: `iced_aw/font.ttf` (`ICED_AW_FONT_BYTES`), with six
glyphs at U+E800..U+E805: `cancel`, `down-open`, `left-open`, `right-open`, `up-open`, `ok`.
Signex draws them itself: `iced_aw/tools/build_font.py` builds the file from straight
strokes, so the font is Signex's own work under Apache-2.0. It replaced the Fontello build
upstream ships, whose glyph source (likely Entypo, CC BY 4.0) could not be confirmed (#2031).
The codepoints, the family name `iced_aw` and the advance widths are unchanged, so the
widgets need no change. Rebuild with `python vendor/iced_aw/tools/build_font.py`
(needs `fonttools`; built with 4.67.0, and the output is byte-identical) after editing a glyph.

`iced_fonts` ships no font files: every `include_bytes!` in its `src/lib.rs` is behind a
feature (`bootstrap`, `codicon`, `devicon`, `fontawesome`, `lucide`, `nerd`, `octicons`,
`pomicons`), and `iced_aw` enables only `advanced_text`. The font files and the showcase
images were removed because they were never compiled in and several carried licences the
repo does not accept (codicon CC BY 4.0, FontAwesome OFL 1.1 without its licence text,
`nerd.ttf` bundling codicons). Enabling one of those features needs the font file and its
licence text added back first.

## Cargo.toml headers

`*/Cargo.toml` still carry the "AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED BY CARGO" header, but they are
hand-edited and the `Cargo.toml.orig` next to them is not kept in step.
